description: This file defines an object `VoiceWakeCommandExtractor` with a method to extract voice commands from a given text, based on trigger words. It includes logic for trimming, regex matching, and cleaning extracted commands, along with a helper function to identify punctuation characters.

methods.name: extractCommand
methods.description: Extracts a command from input text based on provided trigger words, using regex to identify and clean the command segment.

methods.name: isPunctuation
methods.description: Determines if a character is a punctuation character based on Unicode character type.
